name: Deck Dungeon
hook: Build your deck. Guard your friends. Beat the king.
how: Climb a branching dungeon of fights, shops and campfires. Every turn everyone plans their cards at once (attacks, blocks, heals for allies), then it all plays out; win a fight and pick a new card for your deck.
controls: Click or tap cards to play them, then who to use them on, then End turn; tap a room on the map to vote. Keys 1–5 pick cards, Enter ends the turn
uses: The deepest floor each player's party reached.
Bots play every hero nobody has, and play for you if your timer runs out.
The host's browser deals the cards, runs the monsters and resolves each turn; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Everyone sees each other's planned cards, so you can work together.
ideas: Make it a space station with robots instead of monsters
Add a card that gives an ally an extra energy
Add a treasure room that gives everyone a rare card
